objective: Independently measure, at recorded sha256s, whether the canonical F1/F2a/F2b schemas share one frozen data class, because (a) transfer rule T1 in research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml requires 'data_class fields must match exactly (including s, delta once F2 fixes them)' before the licensed AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN => AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN conclusion strengthening may be used, and (b) the G-FORM unmet list in research_map/research_map.json asserts 'no single frozen data class (s,delta,norm) is shared by F1/F2a/F2b, which disables the licensed C0=>C2 transfer', while the authoring taxonomy rev8 asserts the opposite in class_contracts.AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN.data_class_freeze ('identical across F1/F2a/F2b'). This artifact is a measurement, not a gate verdict and not a node status.

comparison_tiers_fixed_before_run.T0_raw_block: byte comparison of the raw text block from the top-level 'data_class:' line to the next top-level key (column-0 key), per schema.
comparison_tiers_fixed_before_run.T1_canonical_json: equality of the full data_class subtree serialized as canonical JSON (sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')) after YAML parse; whitespace/formatting-insensitive but content-sensitive.
comparison_tiers_fixed_before_run.T2_core_keys_strict: equality of the pre-registered CORE_KEYS leaf set (listed in audit.py, fixed before the run) with whitespace collapsing only.
comparison_tiers_fixed_before_run.T3_core_keys_normalized: T2 after dropping (i) parenthesized fragments and (ii) text after the first ';' in each leaf, then collapsing whitespace and stripping trailing punctuation. Every dropped fragment is enumerated in the output so the normalization is auditable. T3 is reported as a convenience reading, never as the sole basis for the verdict.

controls_fixed_before_run.sensitivity_positive: regularity.extension_regularity must differ between F2a (C2) and F2b (C0); if the extraction cannot see this known difference, the comparison machinery is not sensitive and the run is invalid.
controls_fixed_before_run.self_equality_negative: F1 compared with itself must be equal at every tier.
controls_fixed_before_run.projection_non_vacuity: every CORE_KEY must resolve in every schema; a missing key is reported, not silently skipped.
controls_fixed_before_run.hash_stability: all five inputs are hashed before and after the measurement; any change voids the measurement at the changed path and both hashes are reported.

falsifier: If all three canonical data_class subtrees compare equal at T1, or all CORE_KEYS compare equal at T2, then the G-FORM unmet item 'no single frozen data class (s,delta,norm) is shared by F1/F2a/F2b' is refuted at the measured hashes and the authoring data_class_freeze claim is confirmed; the artifact must report that outcome. If any difference is found, the (path, file, line, value) witness list is the deliverable and the unmet item stands at exactly the strength of the difference found (T1 textual/annotation-level versus T2/T3 mathematical). Any change of an input sha256 across the measurement window voids the measurement at that path.
authority_note: Worker output only. Does not set status=done, validation_status=passed, or any gate verdict. Canonical paths are authoritative per research_map/ASTRA_HANDOFF.md and research_map/research_map.json publication_status.policy.
limitations: T3 normalization drops parenthetical and post-semicolon text; in principle this could hide substantive content, so every dropped fragment is listed in dataclass_alignment.json for independent audit.
Line numbers are value-node start lines from the YAML composer, not hand-checked offsets.
Only the three vacuum schemas F1/F2a/F2b are compared; AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH is out of scope.
The measurement reports both the strict T1 reading and the core T2/T3 readings; it does not decide which reading transfer rule T1 should use.
